svg.title: Break the Quiet Days — Srijan's 2026 Contribution Fortress
svg.desc: A static full-year game preview. 195 quiet days are destructible; 60 dates with recorded contributions are protected pass-through energy shields.
svg.text: BREAK THE QUIET DAYS · 2026 CONTRIBUTION FORTRESS
Clear the quiet dates. Every recorded contribution remains an indestructible pass-through energy shield.
Quiet-run depth sets 1–3 hit durability. The linked game adds real collision physics, cracks, fragments, combos, and lives.
